rule.statement: Section 34 of the Civil Procedure Code does not debar the institution of two separate actions on two different causes of action, even though the causes of action arise from the same transaction.
rule.supporting_quote: Similarly, in KANDIAH vs. KANDASAMY [73 NLR 27 105], T.S. Fernando J held that, Section 34 of the Civil Procedure Code does not debar the institution of two separate actions on two different causes of action, even though the causes of action arise from the same transaction.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 34 of the Civil Procedure Code
